title: Teaching Yourself to Paint
content: In thisYouTube interview, I chat with veteran art teachersMarshall Vandruffand Stan Prokopenko, founder of the online tutorial sourceProko.com.We talk about strategies for learning to draw and paint, both for students enrolled in art school and and people doing it on their own.Here are some Amazon links to books that we mention.YouTube:James Gurney's Self-Education JourneyBooks:Norman Rockwell, illustratorBridgman's Complete Guide to Drawing From LifeFigure Drawing for All It's Worthby LoomisThe Human Figureby VanderpoelPaul Chadwick, Concrete Volume 1: DepthsThe Artist's Guide to SketchingImaginative Realism: How to Paint What Doesn't ExistColor and Light: A Guide for the Realist PainterPrevious posts:Survival Guide for Art StudentsFire and Ice series
